title.zh: 动量与碰撞 · 速度不是全部
title.en: Momentum & Collisions · Speed Is Not the Whole Story

description.zh: 动量是质量乘速度的账本：同样的速度，质量不同，动量就不同。碰撞时动量总守恒，冲量（力乘时间）是动量改变多少；弹性碰撞还守恒动能，粘性碰撞只守恒动量。
description.en: Momentum is the mass-times-velocity ledger: same speed, different mass, different momentum. Total momentum is always conserved in a collision; impulse (force times time) is how much it changes. Elastic collisions also conserve kinetic energy; sticky ones conserve momentum only.

label.zh: 碰撞是力在极短时间里改动量
label.en: A collision is force changing momentum in a brief moment

reason.zh: 速度变了，变的正是动量；净力是动量变化的原因，碰撞把这个变化压缩进一瞬间，动量账本就是牛顿第二定律的账本。
reason.en: When velocity changes, what changes is momentum; net force is the cause of that change, and a collision squeezes it into a brief moment — the momentum ledger is Newton's second law kept as accounts.

label.zh: 冲量就是动量改变多少
label.en: Impulse is how much momentum changes

reason.zh: 力乘时间等于动量改变量：同样的动量要停住，时间越长平均力越小——冲量不是新量，是动量变化的另一种说法。
reason.en: Force times time equals the change in momentum: to stop the same momentum, more time means less average force — impulse is not a new quantity, it is the momentum change stated another way.

label.zh: 两条账本同时对账，才分得清弹性与粘性
label.en: Two ledgers reconciled together tell elastic from sticky

reason.zh: 弹性碰撞动量与动能都守恒，粘性碰撞只守恒动量、多余的动能变热散掉；只看一条账本，分不清这两种碰撞。
reason.en: Elastic collisions conserve both momentum and kinetic energy; sticky ones conserve momentum only and lose the rest as heat. One ledger alone cannot tell the two apart.
